```{r tutorial-content, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
text <- readLines("../README.md", warn = FALSE)
text <- text[-1L] # The vignette title is supplied by its YAML metadata.
text <- gsub("vignettes/figures/", "figures/", text, fixed = TRUE)
section <- ""
for (i in seq_along(text)) {
    if (grepl("^## ", text[i])) section <- text[i]
    if (identical(text[i], "```r")) {
        text[i] <- if (section == "## Installation") "```{r, eval=FALSE}" else "```{r}"
    }
}
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = text, quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```
